name: IBY_SETUP_EXTENSIBILITY
description: This table stores the additional and extensible information about any payment setup entity.

columns.name: ATTRIBUTE_ID
columns.description: Extensible attribute identifier.

columns.name: ENTITY_CODE
columns.description: Database object name for which the additional data is stored in this table

columns.name: ENTITY_ID
columns.description: Primary key identifier value for which this additional data belongs to in ENTITY_CODE object.

columns.name: ATTRIBUTE_TYPE
columns.description: Lookup type mapping for the additional data elements.

columns.name: ATTRIBUTE_CODE
columns.description: Lookup code mapping for the additional data element.

columns.name: ATTRIBUTE_VALUE
columns.description: Value of the additional or extensible data for an ATTRIBUTE_CODE.

columns.name: START_DATE
columns.description: Date when the funding card account assignment to the virtual card program becomes active.

columns.name: END_DATE
columns.description: Date when the funding card account assignment to the virtual card program becomes inactive.

columns.name: CREATED_FROM
columns.description: The program or UI from which this row is created. Oracle internal use only

columns.name: CREATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who created the row.

columns.name: CREATION_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the creation of the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who last updated the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the last update of the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_LOGIN
columns.description: Who column: indicates the session login associated to the user who last updated the row.

columns.name: OBJECT_VERSION_NUMBER
columns.description: Used to implement optimistic locking. This number is incremented every time that the row is updated. The number is compared at the start and end of a transaction to detect whether another session has updated the row since it was queried.
